versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the autoglm-file-upload skill.
- Upload local files (images, documents, etc.) to the AutoGLM server and obtain a file URL or resource ID for downstream API use.
- Automatically retrieves authorization tokens from a local service—no manual environment variable setup required.
- Supports dynamic header signing and MIME type detection.
- Includes a command-line script (upload-mix.py) for simple file uploads.
- Provides clear instructions on extracting and using the returned file URL for follow-up API workflows.
